items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Lee Glover sent me here, told me you have a five piece band. And I'd like to take you up to Red Dosa, New Mexico.

ctx.x: He said he wanted a band.

Recognize it, yeah. Boy, we was beat. We ain't had nothing, you know. No. George was closed right through the U.S. Yeah, yeah. Well, back then was on the road. I was staying with back. Uh-huh. So, Lee was working, Lee Glover was working at the Hollywood, you know. Uh-huh. See, Hollywood was okay to sing. Yeah. He got stranded on the show with us, you know. Uh-huh. And he was singing, so Mr. Cliff, oh, I like to call that man name. Uh-huh. And they come around there and say they're looking for a band. They go…
What kind of piano player you called him? Huh? What did you call him?
